name: base
title: Base
description: Cascade layer order, global focus ring, skip link, screen-reader helper, layout helpers and reduced motion.

a11y.pattern: Global focus-visible ring, .di-skip-link, .di-sr-only, reduced-motion media query
keyboard: The skip link is the first stop and becomes visible on focus
aria: Point the skip link at the id of the main landmark (main#main)
a11y.notes: Never remove the focus ring without a replacement that has at least 3:1 contrast. Component CSS lives in the deep-ink.components layer, so your unlayered CSS wins without !important.
